content_sections.heading: HMT Vacancy 2026 Notification PDF
content_sections.text: Candidates who are interested in applying for the HMT Recruitment 2026 should first download and carefully read the official notification PDF. The notification contains complete details about vacancy distribution, eligibility criteria, age limit, stipend/salary, selection process, important dates, and application instructions. Reading the official document is important to ensure that you meet all requirements before submitting the application form. Download HMT Job 2026 Notification PDF

content_sections.heading: HMT Recruitment 2026 - Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: Consultant (Legal): LL.B. from a recognized University/College/Institute with a good academic record. LL.M. is desirable. Consultant (Finance): CA/CMA/ICWA. Young Professional-II (Finance): CA/CMA/ICWA. Young Professional-I (Finance): CA/CMA/ICWA. Young Professional-I (Official Language): Master's degree in Hindi, with English as a major or elective subject at the Graduation level or Master's degree in English, with Hindi as a major or elective subject at the Graduation level. Young Professional-I (Company Secretary): Graduation with ACS Qualification or Qualified Company Secretary having membership of the Institute of Company Secretaries of India (ICSI).

content_sections.heading: HMT Recruitment 2026 - Age Limit
content_sections.text: Maximum Age Limit: 45 years for all posts. Candidates are advised to check whether they satisfy the prescribed age limit before applying. Use our online Age Calculator to calculate your exact age instantly.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for HMT Various Posts Recruitment 2026 through offline mode should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Download the application form from the official website: . Fill the application form carefully with correct information. Attach self-attested copies of required documents such as photograph, signature, ID proof, and certificates. Check all details carefully before submission. Send the completed application form to the address mentioned in the notification through Speed Post / Registered Post or as instructed. Ensure the application reaches before the last date: 09-10-2026. Keep a photocopy of the submitted application form for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application for the HMT Consultant / Young Professional posts is 09 October 2026. Ensure your application reaches the designated address by this date.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Hindustan Machine Tools (HMT) is recruiting for a total of 7 vacancies for the posts of Consultant and Young Professional.

faq.question: Q3. What is the educational qualification required for HMT posts?
faq.answer: The educational qualifications vary by post, including LL.B., CA/CMA/ICWA, Master's degrees in Hindi/English, and Company Secretary qualifications.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for applying to HMT vacancies?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for all the Consultant and Young Professional posts is 45 years.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the HMT Consultant / Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The salary ranges from Rs. 45,000/- to Rs. 80,000/- per month, depending on the specific post and consultant level.

faq.question: Q6. What is the application mode for HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The application process for HMT Recruitment 2026 is strictly offline. Candidates need to download the form and send it via post.

faq.question: Q7. Is there any application fee for HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) in the official notification for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for HMT Consultant / Young Professional posts?
faq.answer: The selection process for these positions will be based on an interview. Candidates will be shortlisted based on their qualifications and experience.

faq.question: Q9. Where is the job location for HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The job location for these posts is Bengaluru, Karnataka, with the pincode 560032.

faq.question: Q10. Can candidates apply through email for HMT Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No, the application mode is offline only. Applications must be sent via post to the address specified in the official notification. Email applications will not be considered.
